title: envelope
description: The wire envelope of every MissionForge message: one JSON object per WebSocket text frame. The payload `d` is validated against `<t>.schema.json`.

t.description: Message type: lower-case dotted name listed in messages.md.

seq.description: Sender-assigned sequence number. Starts at 1 on each connection and in each direction and increases by 1 per message.

d.description: Payload object, possibly empty. Its schema is selected by `t`.
